text:
قال الله تعالى: [وَلْتَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى الْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ]
روي عن النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله) أنه قال: (كيف بكم إذا فسدت نساؤكم وفسق شبابكم ولم تأمروا بالمعروف ولم تنهوا عن المنكر) فقيل له: ويكون ذلك يا رسول الله؟ قال صلى الله عليه وآله: (نعم). فقال: (كيف بكم إذا أمرتم بالمنكر ونهيتم عن المعروف) فقيل له: يا رسول الله ويكون ذلك؟ فقال: (نعم وشر من ذلك كيف بكم إذا رأيتم المعروف منكراً والمنكر معروفاً؟). 
وقد روي عنهم (عليهم السلام): أن بالأمر بالمعروف تقام الفرائض وتأمن المذاهب وتحل المكاسب، وتمنع المظالم وتعمر الأرض وينتصف للمظلوم من الظالم ولا يزال الناس بخير ما أمروا بالمعروف، ونهوا عن المنكر، وتعاونوا على البر فإذا لم يفعلوا ذلك نزعت منهم البركات وسلط بعضهم على بعض ولم يكن لهم ناصر في الأرض ولا في السماء


من آثار ترك الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر

text:
Wouldn't call myself a BMTH fan and I don't know anything like all of their songs, but when I heard Throne, Drown and True Friends I thought "I could get on board with this", I was mostly convinced by Oli Sykes' feature in Silence Speaks by WSS. Then they brought this stuff out and there hasn't been one song that's for me. Which is fine, they can go with whatever sound they like, but I can see that they've definitely gotten more radio-friendly. It could easily seem like they might've gone after the money and I can see how that has rubbed their fans the wrong way. They also get a hell of a lot more radio play than ever before and some edgy kids don't like their favourite bands to be successful... 
People don't like change, but you can't demand anything from anyone. If it doesn't suit you go listen to and support other bands that could always use it and enjoy the old music that the band made.

text:
Maybe I Just Need to Rest

I’m 21 years old, but I carry a kind of exhaustion that feels much older than I am.

My days have become nothing more than working, coming home, and trying to recover energy that never seems to come back. Little by little, I’ve pulled away from people. I leave messages unanswered, turn down invitations, and isolate myself — not because I’ve stopped loving anyone, but because even talking requires a strength I no longer have.

I come home looking for peace, but I can’t find it. There’s not enough space, not enough silence, and too much noise outside and inside my head. At work, I swallow hurtful words and humiliation because I need the money. And at the end of the month, I’m still counting debts, regretting what I spent, and realizing there’s barely enough left even for the simple things I want for myself.

But maybe the heaviest part is looking at the people I love and not being able to help them. Watching my dad live with pain, my mom wake up with her body hurting, both of them worrying about rent, food, and bills, while all I wish is that I could say, “Let me take care of it.”

And when I look at myself, I find things that need fixing too. My face, my room, my choices, my money, my life. So I cry in secret, lose patience with the people I love, and then blame myself for it. For the messages I never answered, the family I’ve grown distant from, the invitations I turned down, and the feeling that life is passing me by.

I’m 21, and sometimes I feel like I should be so much further ahead.

But maybe I’m not behind.
Maybe I’m just trying to carry too many things at once.

I don’t want a perfect life, and I don’t want to run away from everything.

I just want a little silence.
A place where my things can fit, where my mind can finally switch off, and where, for a little while, no problem needs to be solved.

Maybe I’m just looking for a place where I can fit too — and finally rest.

text:
Stars at noon” refers to the phenomenon where stars are actually always present in the sky — even during the day — but the sun is so overwhelmingly bright that it drowns them out completely.
It’s often used as a metaphor for:
	•	Things that exist but can’t be seen in the current conditions — truth, beauty, or wisdom that’s present but obscured by noise or distraction.
	•	Being overlooked despite being there — something valuable hidden in plain sight.
	•	Humility of the ordinary — the extraordinary is always around us; we just rarely have the right conditions to notice it.

text:
“The Lord is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
‭‭Psalms‬ ‭34‬:‭18‬. 
Jesus came down from heaven, lived a sinless life, died for us on the cross, and rose again 3 days later, defeating sin and death for all time. All have sinned and rebelled against God (Romans 3:23-24) (not including Jesus since He is God). The wages of our sin is death (Romans 6:23). But “God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, so that whoever believes in Him should not perish (not go to hell) but have eternal life” - John 3:16. God loves you and wants a relationship with you and you have to believe in Him and love Him and repent (turn away from sin) and follow Him and you will be saved. “that if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved“ - Romans 10:9. God will change you and your heart and He will make your arrogant and evil heart of stone into a kind and loving heart that is obedient to His commandments which are perfect, as He has changed me. He will change you so that you can love Him and love others, as He changed me, even though we fall short of God’s glory by sinning. Surrender your life to Christ and believe today and be reconciled with your loving Creator and know the God who made everything and everyone who doesn’t delight in the death of the wicked: “Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord GOD, and not rather that he should turn from his way and live?” - Ezekiel 18:23.  Also, “The Lord is not slow about His promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing for any to perish but for all to come to repentance.” - 2 Peter‬ ‭3‬:‭9‬. God loves us so much that He wants all to come to repentance and is patient with us and doesn’t punish us for our sin if we allow Jesus to take our sin off of us because He died in our place because we deserved death for our sin so Jesus, having never sinned, died in our place. “He made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.” - ‭‭2 Corinthians‬ ‭5‬:‭21. But He will punish those who continually reject Him or who have rejected Him even until death. The time is soon, Jesus is coming back, and many aren’t saved. Don’t wait! Accept the gift of salvation which God gifts us and believe in Jesus because God has promised that if we believe in Jesus (Who is God), we will receive eternal salvation. “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—” - Ephesians 2:8. Repent (turn away from sin and resist temptation to sin) and come to Christ who will take your sin away, give you a new heart to love God and love others, and He will save you from condemnation on judgement day when He judges everyone for what they have done. What an offer! “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.” - Romans 6:23. Praise God!

the music of the spheres—
appreciating all.

from “my”
to what always was

text:
“The Lord is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
‭‭Psalms‬ ‭34‬:‭18‬. 
Jesus came down from heaven, lived a sinless life, died for us on the cross, and rose again 3 days later, defeating sin and death for all time. All have sinned and rebelled against God (Romans 3:23-24) (not including Jesus since He is God). The wages of our sin is death (Romans 6:23). But “God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, so that whoever believes in Him should not perish (not go to hell) but have eternal life” - John 3:16. God loves you and wants a relationship with you and you have to believe in Him and love Him and repent (turn away from sin) and follow Him and you will be saved. “that if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved“ - Romans 10:9. God will change you and your heart and He will make your arrogant and evil heart of stone into a kind and loving heart that is obedient to His commandments which are perfect, as He has changed me. He will change you so that you can love Him and love others, as He changed me, even though we fall short of God’s glory by sinning. Surrender your life to Christ and believe today and be reconciled with your loving Creator and know the God who made everything and everyone who doesn’t delight in the death of the wicked: “Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord GOD, and not rather that he should turn from his way and live?” - Ezekiel 18:23.  Also, “The Lord is not slow about His promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing for any to perish but for all to come to repentance.” - 2 Peter‬ ‭3‬:‭9‬. God loves us so much that He wants all to come to repentance and is patient with us and doesn’t punish us for our sin if we allow Jesus to take our sin off of us because He died in our place because we deserved death for our sin so Jesus, having never sinned, died in our place. “He made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.” - ‭‭2 Corinthians‬ ‭5‬:‭21. But He will punish those who continually reject Him or who have rejected Him even until death. The time is soon, Jesus is coming back, and many aren’t saved. Don’t wait! Accept the gift of salvation which God gifts us and believe in Jesus because God has promised that if we believe in Jesus (Who is God), we will receive eternal salvation. “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—” - Ephesians 2:8. Repent (turn away from sin and resist temptation to sin) and come to Christ who will take your sin away, give you a new heart to love God and love others, and He will save you from condemnation on judgement day when He judges everyone for what they have done. What an offer! “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.” - Romans 6:23. Praise God!

text: i cant stress how much i relate to this song because of my childhood best friend. We met in 3rd grade and quickly bonded over lego and the color blue.. we became basically attached at the hip, and inseparable, going to the park, going skiing, having playdates at midnight in his basement. I moved to a different country (singapore) and lived there for 4 years due to my dads work. during that time, we obviously lost touch a bit but i dont think anyone could understand me as much as he did. I came back the summer before high school to our town and he was the first to visit me after i went theough a major mental crisis and ended up in the hospital at 13. we were back to being close but considered eachother "bros" for a while unril i realized I had feelings for him and distanced myself because i was scared. In 10th grade i got a bf and he started dating another girl the following year. i feel like we have so much wasted potential from our shared history and how we just "clicked", because he would look at me like he liked me sometimes. So im confused. He made a cover of this song on his account, i dont know what to think. i might be deluding myself into thinking it has anything to co with me but i certainlt hope our moments meant something tohim, cuz he was and still IS everything to me. im so sorry for the unnecessary lore drop but yeah 🤕

text:
Day 12 of asking Rex Orange County to come to Singapore! 🇸🇬 [Song 12] 

Also a small(ish) review on Best Friend:
- the intro is so simplistic yet so beautiful! his voice is just wonderful throughout this whole song, you can tell that he's holding back in the intro! the subtle changes in his tone make his vocals just pop so much! the rex orange county speciality!
- the guitar oh this song is mixed great! i love its use in the chorus especially!
- the 1st chorus is just SOO GOOD!!! his voice is just so nice to listen to! hes not really trying to put 100% into it and casually singing in his house, plus the solo guitar, makes it sound like it was produced in a bedroom instead of studio! this is the basis for his main genre of 'bedroom pop'!
- the guitar after the chorus (0:58) if sped up, makes the song feel bouncy, which is similar to his last song 'Uno' (might be abit of a stretch) - its still super nice here! its also gives the song here a much more calm and 'vibey' sort of feel.
- i like how the drums + guitar gets slightly faster at 1:24! it stops the song from feeling too boring since that tempo was kinda slow.
- at 1:38 - 1:46, he has since changed the lyrics to this part in future concerts to "you're not(changed) my favorite girl. you better trust me when i tell you there is someone(changed) else more beautiful in this damn world" - this part also changes to add claps + more speed to increase the energy of the song to lead into the kinda false climax.
- the shakers + cords + claps he uses makes first the best friend lyric sound kinda tropical?
- the 4x best friend part of this song is pretty nice, especially the last one, and reinforces how he feels like his relationship with a person he likes is gong, but it does feel abit repetitive and breaks the flow of the song abit. maybe making it go only 3x would have been better?
- THE DROP IS JUST TOOO GOOD!!! ITS INSANE HOW HYPE AND FUN THIS 2ND CHORUS IS!!1!
- the intro of horns into this last chorus also increases the energy of it!
- THE TRUMPET SOLO + REX/ALEX'S VOICE IS SOOOO GOOD? LIKE WHAT?
- the de-escalation of the instrumentals, then the angelic outro is just too good!
- this song is about rex/alex's relationship with a person he likes. their relationship currently is one of best friends or just friends, but he wants to make them his gf so he competes with the other guys in her life to become her 'favorite boy'.
- he may have already confressed to her but got rejected, so hes trying to still win her back. (i'm not great at analysis, sorry)

OVERALL: i love this song, you love this song. it is the song i've listened to the most on spotify EVER, it is my favorite song BY FAR! it is just too good, and it deserves to be his no. 1 song. get this to 1 billion streams!

10/10!

Another banger, next is: Sunflower (single)

二、核心重要句子
我说，哦，我被灯光照得眼花缭乱。
拼音：Wǒ shuō, ó, wǒ bèi dēngguāng zhào de yǎnhuāliáoluàn.
英文：I said, ooh, I'm blinded by the lights.
西班牙语：Dije: oh, las luces me deslumbran.
逐词分析
1. 我 wǒ — I / me — yo
2. 说 shuō — say / said — decir / dije
3. 哦 ó — oh / ooh — oh
4. 我 wǒ — I / me — yo
5. 被 bèi — passive marker — marcador de voz pasiva

text:
I miss you.

Sometimes I still look back at the water
and wish I had been strong enough
to pull you back to shore.

I tried to be your lifeboat,
your steady hands,
the person who would never let you sink.

But every time I reached for you,
you pulled me deeper.

And I kept telling myself
that love meant holding on,
even when my lungs were tired,
even when I could barely keep myself above water.

I wanted to save you.
God, I wanted to save you.

But I finally understood
I can’t teach you to swim
while you’re drowning me.

So I let go.

Not because I stopped loving you.
Not because I stopped caring.
But because I was disappearing beneath the waves too.

I swam toward the shore
with the hardest truth I’ve ever had to carry.

Sometimes loving someone
means leaving them in the water
and hoping they finally choose to swim.

I still turn around sometimes.

I still wish I could jump back in
and bring you home.

but the tide has carried us too far apart.

And as much as it hurts me,

I have to trust that someday
you’ll learn to swim without me.

text: This song was so painful to listen to but I couldn't stop listening to it after being left by my 1st love. I had to admit that all the problems were caused by me because of my stupidity & childishness. I didnt fall in love till I was 35, had no experience with it which led me to act immature & unreasonable when relationship issues rose up. I cried multiple times a day & tried to fix the unfixable. She would give me hope of rekindling our relationship one day & shutting me down the next in an endless cycle of happines & sorrow that truly becomes addictive. Women can make a hardened man soft & men can make a gentle woman turn to cold, hardened steel, its almost unavoidable. If your partner doesn't fight for the relationship as hard as u fight for it then perhaps its not meant to be. Please trust the process, I know its hard to give up but your heart will mend in time & you'll soon feel foolish for thinking & acting like a child in adulthood. It may feel like its not over yet but man up, rub some dirt on it, accept what you don't want to accept & move on from that addictive pain, you deserve someone who won't let you go through that kind of deep sorrow. Get off your knees & onto your feet as a new, stronger version of yourself...be a selfish person for a short period of time to heal your heart. Its a "must" in order for you to move on, have more respect for yourself & realize it ain't the end of the world. Get your paper up & surround yourself with FAMILY...begin the rebuild process with a smile on your face & an "i don't give af about him/her anymore" mentality.....or not lol I may be wrong about this advice but its all up to u at the end of the day. Just do your best in your journey and learn from the mistakes you made.

Now we’re racing home together with the windows rolling down.

Now my stomach’s leading every morning walk.
Thought I was a champion, thought I couldn’t fall,
Then the Crunchwrap hit me like a wrecking ball.
Yeah, we laughed, we feasted, made some questionable calls…
Last night we let the Taco Bell talk.

Felt like culinary genius with my late-night food defense.
Sun came up, reality came knockin’ at the door,
Now I’m making promises I’ve definitely made before.

Final Chorus
Last night we let the Taco Bell talk,
Today I’m walking just a little funny on the block.
I’ll swear I’m done forever… ’til next Friday night,
When that drive-thru beacon shines so bright.
’Cause history repeats when hunger comes to call…
Last night we let the Taco Bell talk.

text: Llevo 57 años siendo joven. Hace poco entré en éxtasis al escuchar a The Cure en un Pub, ¿te lo puedes creer?. Dejé volar mi cuerpo sin importarme nada. Es lo que te da la edad, ya te da igual lo que piensen los demás. Y ahora descubro este album. Enciendo el equipo de música que tengo. De los de antes, con sus altavoces y su amplificador. Le pongo una copa a mi mujer y yo me pongo otra. Y empezamos a escuchar este maravilloso album, y después Just Like Heaven, y Lovesong, y The Last Day of Summer... Aparece el mayor de mis cuatro hijos y se sienta a escuchar música con nosotros. En estos momentos diría que tenemos la misma edad. Va a ser una noche maravillosa... Gracias The Cure (y también a The Smiths).

text: Running the risk that you all are going to try and kill me, what is this thing with the latest album of The Cure. I'm sure you all think that The Forest was epic, and I can understand that, but it was never a game changer in the era of New Wave. They just went along for the money and there were far better daring bands. I'm not mentioning any name as I don't want to start a debate. So, basically, I never was a fan. But... I can't stop listening to their latest album. I guess there's only one song that doesn't really does it for me, but the rest. If you want me to pick one song I would say "Endsong" but than again, only if you force me. I think this is great and never thought I would even express this feeling. Way to go Robert !!!!

text: This album is not The Cure.  I'm not versed in music production, but I recognize James, the haphazard trajectory of his acts and alter egos.  This is overproduced.  The instrumentation on track two, for instance, is clearly not The Cure, despite its layered complexity and the extensive range of James' sound.  AI/James 2.0, the successors, have too many toys.  The live tracks before this release had more emotional depth.  But there were red flags, things James would never do- cry on stage; act out songs; exhale as if he were demoing the Radiohead song, "Fitter, Happier", instead of a razor-sharp mind given to extremes.  James is delicate.  His expressiveness does not involve limbs, though I did see him wipe his nose once.  It was adorable.  When James emotes, it's not rehearsed but spontaneous, as if he were in a trance, reliving experiences and the emotional palette of a song at every show.  I've seen him emotionally exhausted after the intensity of "Prayers for Rain", profound sadness of "Plainsong, revulsion of "Disintegration and playful the next instant, whilst playing to the crowd, not just the passionate fans.  "And the birds falling out of the sky", that is excellent AI angst.  Why I'd think my boyfriend James lives, & not Souly within me.

text: My dad died 15 months ago and it feels like it was yesterday. I have very little experience with grief. I don’t even know if what I am feeling is grief.  It comes in waves. Big waves and little waves.  I never knew what it felt like when someone grieving would say a piece of them felt like it had died. Well, I 100% feel like a piece of me died. I wish I could remove the way that feels. Asmr and music helps me.  The Cure helps me for sure. Been my fav band since 8th grade (1991/92).  Good luck on your grief process. I'm just realizing the that the name the cure has actually been somewhat of a cure for my grieving process.  It's like Robert Smith knew to name the band The Cure.  So many layers to the name now.

After 33 years of marriage and 35 years together. And five children three daughters and two sons. 
I never saw the red flags and I suffered for a very long time from the one that I gave my everything my life over half of my life had been baiting, and gaslighting me for years. And claiming she didn’t know what she was doing. I never knew it. I was breadcrumbed with attention and affection never getting what I had been giving. It got to where I would have to practically beg her for attention and affection of any kind 
For hugs anything just to hold hands while going for a walk. I got nothing in return. I’ve often wondered how some people can stay together 30-40 and even 50 years and get divorced. I unfortunately found out one reason the hard way. I can’t keep allowing someone to rip out my heart trying to feed their narcissistic needs. One of the hardest things was hearing one of my children tell me what their mother was doing to me.

text:
Я не знаю, что тебе сказать. 
Не знаю. Мне не хочется ничего говорить. Не вынуждай меня на общение.
Я хочу помолчать. Нас сейчас атакуют эти ублюдки. Хочу быть со своим  городом.
Во мне сейчас к тебе унылое ничего. Я знаю, что это пройдёт. Но ещё знаю, что дальше будет появляться все чаще. 
Любить тебя или оставить тебя? Я не оставлю тебя, потому что при всей крутизне в тебе есть бреши, которые не позволят тебе реализовать твоё Предназначение без моей энергии. Сейчас война, всё очень остро и сложно, поэтому меня должно быть с тобой больше, чем в мирное время. Если хочешь, могу перестать проявляться, чтобы не раздражать тебя, но присутствовать на твоих каналах все равно буду. Если  и там не заблочишь меня, конечно)).
Мне не нравятся такие отношения. Я ничего с этим поделать не могу. Мне скучно и я глупо себя чувствую. Прости.
Я, конечно, буду писать. И пишу. Я Люблю тебя, Родной. Очень Люблю. Но это просто мука смертная, такая Любовь. Ты тысячу раз самый лучший и самый классный. Но я не знаю, чем продиктовано твоё поведение по отношению ко мне. И это меня сильно тормозит психологически.
Я всегда рада тебя видеть и слышать. И всегда соблюдаю и буду соблюдать твои интересы, но о какой страсти и доверии может идти речь в таких условиях, как наши?
Может пробьёт меня. Хочу в это верить. Знаю, что тебе нужны мои Чувства и хорошее настроение. Поэтому хочу писать тебе тогда, когда чувствую окрыленность к тебе, а не просто так.
Окрыленность стала появляться реже). Ты всё время ломаешь мне крылья). Может быть, так нужно и правильно, но я не знаю об этом ничего наверняка. Поэтому и отращивать новые не хочется. Ничего, совершенно над собой усилие и отращу)
Ради тебя❤
Если до того момента ты опять не взбесишься, и не сделаешь мне очередную подножку.

Люблю тебя💋
Спокойной ночки💋

text:
Surah Luqman
Luqman

Select SURAH
Reciters: Mishary Alafasy ● Aziz Alili ● Al-Hussayni Al-'Azazy ● Abdul Basit ● Saad Ghamdi ● Salah Al-Hashim ● Mahmoud Al-Husary ● Muhammad Jibreel ● Abdullah Juhany ● Abdul Hadi Kanakeri ● Muhammad Al-Minshawi ● Maher Al-Muayqili ● Abu Bakr Al-Shatri ● Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais ● Wadee Hammadi Al-Yamani
 

Transliteration
English
Arabic
Translators: Ahmed Ali ● Amatul Rahman Omar ● Daryabadi ● Faridul Haque ● Hamid S. Aziz ● Maulana Mohammad Ali ● Pickthall ● Sarwar ● Shakir ● Yusuf Ali

In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
A. L. M.
These are Verses of the Wise Book,-
A Guide and a Mercy to the Doers of Good,-
Those who establish regular Prayer, and give regular Charity, and have (in their hearts) the assurance of the Hereafter.
These are on (true) guidance from their Lord: and these are the ones who will prosper.
But there are, among men, those who purchase idle tales, without knowledge (or meaning), to mislead (men) from the Path of Allah and throw ridicule (on the Path): for such there will be a Humiliating Penalty.
When Our Signs are rehearsed to such a one, he turns away in arrogance, as if he heard them not, as if there were deafness in both his ears: announce to him a grievous Penalty.
For those who believe and work righteous deeds, there will be Gardens of Bliss,-
To dwell therein. The promise of Allah is true: and He is Exalted in Power, Wise.
He created the heavens without any pillars that ye can see; He set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and He scattered through it beasts of all kinds. We send down rain from the sky, and produce on the earth every kind of noble creature, in pairs.
Such is the Creation of Allah: now show Me what is there that others besides Him have created: nay, but the Transgressors are in manifest error.
we bestowed (in the past) Wisdom on Luqman: "Show (thy) gratitude to Allah." Any who is (so) grateful does so to the profit of his own soul: but if any is ungrateful, verily Allah is free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.
Behold, Luqman said to his son by way of instruction: "O my son! join not in worship (others) with Allah: for false worship is indeed the highest wrong-doing."
And We have enjoined on man (to be good) to his parents: in travail upon travail did his mother bear him, and in years twain was his weaning: (hear the command), "Show gratitude to Me and to thy parents: to Me is (thy final) Goal.
"But if they strive to make thee join in worship with Me things of which thou hast no knowledge, obey them not; yet bear them company in this life with justice (and consideration), and follow the way of those who turn to me (in love): in the end the return of you all is to Me, and I will tell you the truth (and meaning) of all that ye did."
"O my son!" (said Luqman), "If there be (but) the weight of a mustard-seed and it were (hidden) in a rock, or (anywhere) in the heavens or on earth, Allah will bring it forth: for Allah understands the finest mysteries, (and) is well-acquainted (with them).
"O my son! establish regular prayer, enjoin what is just, and forbid what is wrong: and bear with patient constancy whatever betide thee; for this is firmness (of purpose) in (the conduct of) affairs.
"And swell not thy cheek (for pride) at men, nor walk in insolence through the earth; for Allah loveth not any arrogant boaster.
"And be moderate in thy pace, and lower thy voice; for the harshest of sounds without doubt is the braying of the ass."
Do ye not see that Allah has subjected to your (use) all things in the heavens and on earth, and has made his bounties flow to you in exceeding measure, (both) seen and unseen? Yet there are among men those who dispute about Allah, without knowledge and without guidance, and without a Book to enlighten them!
When they are told to follow the (Revelation) that Allah has sent down, they say: "Nay, we shall follow the ways that we found our fathers (following). "What! even if it is Satan beckoning them to the Penalty of the (Blazing) Fire?
Whoever submits his whole self to Allah, and is a doer of good, has grasped indeed the most trustworthy hand-hold: and with Allah rests the End and Decision of (all) affairs.
But if any reject Faith, let not his rejection grieve thee: to Us is their return, and We shall tell them the truth of their deeds: for Allah knows well all that is in (men´s) hearts.
We grant them their pleasure for a little while: in the end shall We drive them to a chastisement unrelenting.
If thou ask them, who it is that created the heavens and the earth. They will certainly say, "Allah". Say: "Praise be to Allah!" But most of them understand not.
To Allah belong all things in heaven and earth: verily Allah is He (that is) free of all wants, worthy of all praise.
And if all the trees on earth were pens and the ocean (were ink), with seven oceans behind it to add to its (supply), yet would not the words of Allah be exhausted (in the writing): for Allah is Exalted in Power, full of Wisdom.
And your creation or your resurrection is in no wise but as an individual soul: for Allah is He Who hears and sees (all things).
Seest thou not that Allah merges Night into Day and he merges Day into Night; that He has subjected the sun, and the moon (to his Law), each running its course for a term appointed; and that Allah is well-acquainted with all that ye do?
That is because Allah is the (only) Reality, and because whatever else they invoke besides Him is Falsehood; and because Allah,- He is the Most High, Most Great.
Seest thou not that the ships sail through the ocean by the Grace of Allah?- that He may show you of His Signs? Verily in this are Signs for all who constantly persevere and give thanks.
When a wave covers them like the canopy (of clouds), they call to Allah, offering Him sincere devotion. But when He has delivered them safely to land, there are among them those that halt between (right and wrong). But none reject Our Signs except only a perfidious ungrateful (wretch)!
O mankind! do your duty to your Lord, and fear (the coming of) a Day when no father can avail aught for his son, nor a son avail aught for his father. Verily, the promise of Allah is true: let not then this present life deceive you, nor let the chief Deceiver deceive you about Allah.
Verily the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah (alone). It is He Who sends down rain, and He Who knows what is in the wombs. Nor does any one know what it is that he will earn on the morrow: Nor does any one know in what land he is to die. Verily with Allah is full knowledge and He is acquainted (with all things).

a chip but that’s possible when you have a good team and pieces. 

Year 17 for Kobe which was his last year before his prime got ended by achilles: 

27, 6, 5.6 FG: 46% , people who put Duncan above Kobe just hate him. 

Duncan only above Shaq due to him having 5, otherwise Shaq would also be over him. 

It’s all splitting hairs.

Gotta take in account the stacked teams Bron & Magic playing with & look at the COMP Bron would face UNTIL he got to the finals. 

Meanwhile Kobe would play the tougher comp, better talent otw to the finals and some times IN THE FINALS.

text:
Someone could read this in the future but understand this. We all experience or will experience life lessons. Please don’t let grief or breakups or trauma ruin your life bc you’re not alone. Please don’t be a lost soul & end your life, those are regrets that you’re only holding onto bc things will get better. I’m aware 2025 is not looking good right now but trust me, it’s faith you need to hold onto. It will take time. 

Just like a healing would. Your scars will still be visible to remind you that you’re still here & how you learned from it, it tells a story. So please stop focusing on stressing, financial issues, regrets, etc. Appreciate life, even those people who have passed. (They’re still here anyway, rooting for you all) Just be glad that you have the same experiences as them or that you were there for them. Go outside for walks, clear your mind. Staying on technology forever makes you like that too. Things will get better, promise.

text:
Ian Axel deserves far greater recognition than he has received. Christina Aguilera’s voice is magnificent, but Ian is the emotional heart of this performance. There is something extraordinarily honest in the way he sings—no theatrics, no attempt to overpower the song, just vulnerability, restraint and truth.

“Say Something” may be known around the world, yet too few people know the name and artistry of the man sitting at that piano. Ian is not merely accompanying a superstar; he is an exceptional singer, pianist and songwriter whose quiet presence gives this song its soul.

Some performers impress you with the power of their voice. Ian Axel moves you through what he allows you to feel. He should have become one of the defining singer-songwriters of his generation. This is a timeless performance from a profoundly gifted artist.

text:
My first encounter with MBV was last year when I heard the song “Sometimes” in the movie Lost in Translation. Both Texas Paris and Lost in Translation brought me endless loneliness and solitude last year. This year, I went to the cinema to see the re-release of Texas Paris. On the way, I happened to play “Sometimes,” which led me to click on the Loveless album for the first time. So I listened to the entire album from the very first track.

That's the backdrop to my first encounter with “Come In Alone.” All these elements laid the groundwork, instantly drawing me into the song. My favorite part is the melody of the last two lines in each verse—it perfectly mirrored my state of mind last year. Maybe we've already emerged from loneliness, or maybe we're still in it. That day, listening to this song as I walked into the theater against the sunset, I was just searching for another place to immerse myself, trying to seal off my emotions for another two hours.

This song isn't as famous as others on the album, but it remains my personal favorite.

text:
@joshpearce7182  Shoegaze? One of the most overrated genres in rock history? Dude, Loveless isn't even an album that represents the shoegaze sound in a coherent way. If you listen to the top 10 shoegaze albums on any website, you'll realize that they actually have little or nothing in common with Loveless, which is more of a noise pop and noise rock album.

And well, importance does not equal musical quality. Loveless has 4-5 great songs, the rest just sounds like filler. And if we evaluate the lyrics, it doesn't hold up either. 

And many things on Loveless were done better before and after. This album is simply a breath of awkward adolescence, nothing really transcendental. If you don't believe me, ask other albums from the nineties like Daydream Nation, Nevermind, Laughing Stock, The Great Annihilator. Or the gothic scene, or the alternative rock scene. Loveless where is? In an overrated scene. 

But, if you had another argues, i will be pleasure of listen it.

text: Sounds good except the Harrison's guitar panned too much to the left. It doesn't adhere too well in the mix when you listen to it with airphones, too selective for my liking, as if George doesn't play with the band but has been recorded seperately afterwards. I like that feel in early Beatles in mono like they play live. In fact they did. Sure, you can hear more details here but at the same time you can hear more clearly all that slight sloppiness from George in a few moments, his slightly unsteady hand, it's now more exposed and more obvious. Were it not for that, this would be the best mix. I hope Sir Paul and Ringo read this section.

text:
The Week the Beatles Dominated the Charts

Nothing to do with the video, but, today (Apr 4) is the 60th Anniversary of the Beatles' dominance of the Top Ten, with all five (5) top places.  It was the most significant event of the day, according to sources.  The band had seven (7) more songs in the Hot 100, 12% of the chart, plus two fan songs, We Love You Beatles (the Carefrees, a girl group), and A Letter to the Beatles (the Four Preps).  It was an embarrassment of riches, and all the wags said it wouldn't last, it was just a phase kids were going through.  

Can't Buy Me Love stayed at #1 for five (5) weeks, three weeks later, Love Me Do was #1, for one week.  It would be nine (9) weeks before the Beatles returned to the top of the charts, an eternity considering they'd held the #1 spot all of the nine (9) weeks before April 4, and only missed the three (3) weeks between Can't Buy Me Love and Love Me Do, from February 1 and May 30, 1964.  Peter and Gordon got a #1 for a Lennon/McCartney song, so maybe they'd become songwriters, make a mint, retire, yadayadayada

The Fab Four returned to the top slot, though, with A Hard Day's Night.  Some suggested the phenomenon was over, Beatlemania had run its course, just as they'd said.  A Hard Day's Night, coupled with the stunning film, cemented the Fab Four in the annals of entertainment history.  A black-and-white film, not perfect, but it captured the moment, tongue-n-cheek, memorializing how those heady days, in London, in the film, of course, but American kids were no different, and George's encounter in the ad office nailed teen attitudes at the time.  

I was 14 during this period, 15 when I saw the Beatles with 10,000 of my closest personal friends, at Stapleton Airport in Denver, Aug 26, 1964, and Red Rocks, that night.  Tickets were $3.50, $4.50, and $5.50.  My Dad made almost $5 an hour, so it was affordable.  My parents were like most, aghast at this cultural tornado, and certain it would soon be a thing of the past.  Were they ever in for a shock!

text: Wow.  OK.  WOW!!  Been a fan of the group for over forty years now and I can honestly say I have never heard this number sound better.  Giles Martin obviously "gets it"  where this tune is concerned.  Wanna know--if you are a singing bass player with the proper vocal range--that you have got some playing/singing "chops"?  Try to copy what McCartney is doing here.  The vocal is not easy and does not let up.  The bass part is done with a pick and is brutally relentless.  Though simple in structure, this bass line of Paul's is one of THE most difficult he has ever done as far as I know.  I have played and sung this in the original key (E Major) and tempo live and it was a workout!

text:
@debessar95  Dude, what are you talking about? I have no idea what you mean by that. I wasn't even talking to you either.
To address whatever you're talking about, The Beatles' albums before the White Album never had proper stereo mixes overseen by the band. They thought that stereo was a fad that wouldn't last (a lot of musicians did in the early 60s because it was new & underutilized at first for music). Thus, their first 8 albums' (9 if you count Magical Mystery Tour) stereo mixes were put together by the audio engineers & I assume George Martin. This led to their first 2 albums having bad stereo mixes that pushed most of the instruments to 1 side & all of the vocals to the other.

For 60 years, they were unable to separate out the instruments & vocals into their own channels because they didn't save the master recordings of them separated before they were all mixed into 1-2 channels for the song. The original stereo mixes of these songs from their first 2 albums are NOT the proper way the songs should've been mixed into stereo as a result. Giles & I assume Paul & Ringo would know this better than anyone because they're musicians & music producers & have worked in the industry for decades. I'm willing to bet that if George Martin were still alive, he'd be all for it as well. Thus, when the opportunity came to use the AI technology Peter Jackson developed for the Get Back documentary to separate out the individual elements to let them rebuild the songs properly into stereo from scratch, they took it & these are an amazing results.

Me, personally? These mixes are something I've been wanting since first getting into The Beatles back in the late 2000s when I was a teenager. When I listened to the original stereo mixes of these songs, I always wondered why they were as they were. And now that I know why that is, I'm elated that they're taking the opportunity to correct the mistakes of the past like this. They want to put out a new way to listen to the band's music. They have every right to do things like this. Literally if you don't personally like the new stereo mixes (which have many benefits outside of correcting the older, worse stereo mixes of the first 2 albums, as Sgt. Pepper got a new lease on life & now we can properly hear more of the elements the band recorded for it that were buried or compressed in the previous versions due to the wider soundscapes these mixes offer with modern technology, which the band wanted the audience to be able to appreciate what they put into it, otherwise they wouldn't have put it together the way they did), you can literally go back & listen to the original stereo or mono mixes because they'll always be available & they're not going anywhere, unlike how George Lucas wants people to only watch the special edition Star Wars movies over the original theatrical cuts.
Now, I don't understand why they haven't made the mono mixes of the albums more widely available outside of the 2009 mono mix CDs or reprints of the vinyl releases & I hope they put the mono mixes on digital platforms in the near future, but it's not like you can't track them down if you don't already have them through whatever means.
Your assertion that Giles is somehow ruining The Beatles' reputation & that somehow Paul McCartney somehow "going deaf" means that these remixes were a bad thing is extremely biased & not based in any facts or logic. If the older mixes were being taken off of digital stores or streaming services, I'd understand it better, but they're not. You have nothing legitimate to complain about.

I was in a wheelchair for a surgery when I was six years old and I couldn’t play with the other kids at recess, but my teacher made me feel welcome. It made me feel like I mattered. That is something I will be eternally grateful for Officer light at the schools resource officer at that school just made my time there’re very memorable and I will always love her for that. She is one of my best friend at that school and I hope she goes on to live a happy life. text:
The first time you brought them home, whatever the circumstances, you chose to care for the being you intentionally loved. Loss grips people similarly, in other circumstances in other places and other times. You did nothing wrong, but something feels, or something makes you feel, like an important connection was destroyed. But, just as other circumstances and places and times exist, other people and other connections exist. When you place anger on the world, you place anger on the world that once had that existing connection that you feel no longer exists. But you know that to do so inhibits your ability to take care of the other things you care about. Expressing anger, then, is okay, but it shouldn't be a constant. Anger will not bring them back, but honouring their memory rather than grieving at the expense of your health would keep them alive in some way.

Would it not be wise to seek out the other circumstances that you once shared with them so that you can use the love you gave them on yourself? Would that not be a way to honour their memory? If they could speak, they would want you to avoid hurting your own health just because you think it justifies the loss you incurred. Maybe it would be better to realize you had love to give, and you still have more of it to give to others who need it. Reflect on the first time you met them, and express your grief, but never dwell for long because it will give way to harm in more ways than you can take back.

text:
Ultraviolence, l'album del mio cuore. 
Musicalmente il più affine al mio background musicale, ma ancora di più tutta l'atmosfera sonora così delicata e potente allo stesso tempo, gli arpeggi, gli assoli di chitarra, e i singoli suoni distorti ma sempre armoniosi, sciolgono la mia anima canzone dopo canzone.
Ed insieme ai resti così struggenti, tristi, ma così carichi d'amore tanto da coccolarti, ti fanno entrare dentro al mondo di Lana e ti fanno innamorare non solo della sua musica, ma proprio di lei.
È come fare l'amore, lasciandosi trasportare dalla passione canzone dopo canzone.
"Shared my body and my mind with you" è l'incipit di Cruel World. Al primo verso Lana mette già in chiaro cosa accadrà durante tutta l'esperienza di ascolto di questo album capolavoro.

text: Was fortunate to see him in Kingston, Ontario in October 1971 before the American Pie LP was released. He was the warm-up act for Blood Sweat and Tears and the crowd didn't welcome him as he came on the stage, a few feet from where I sat cross-legged front row on the floor. But he quickly won over the crowd and brought standing ovation after ovation, debuting a handful of songs from the coming record. I believe Vincent was one of them but i know American Pie was. he taught everyone the chorus and broke down sections of the audience to sing different parts, before anyone knew the song. When played it was stunning. On the way home we agreed we had to watch for the record's release, not knowing it would top the charts in a few weeks, and again in 1972. It was a simply amazing show at Queen's University that night. I can't imagine him performing at a lesser level now. Turning a mostly booing audience (due to Viet Nam war protesting) into multiple standing ovations was something to behold. I'm still hoping a live tape exists but that would be too surprising...

text:
It adds another dimension to this song, especially in this exhibition. The static pictures with their "forever young" artist and the singer, his voice showing signs of age, singing his song not like when he composed it as a young guy in his mid-twenties, but as an old man. The meaning, the things we think about while hearing it changes.
For me it's similar to "Hurt" from NIN and Cash - the song remained the same, but it leaves another impression on us.
Age changes a face, a voice - but that doesn't make it less beautiful.

text:
Dear friends, maybe Noam Chomsky was right when he argued that left-wing activists should be careful about spending enormous amounts of emotional, intellectual, and physical energy trying to determine exactly who was responsible for 9/11 or debating every possible theory about how it happened. Was it entirely an external terrorist attack? Was there some element of government negligence or deliberate inaction? Were there explosives involved? Was it a form of "blowback" resulting from American foreign policy? These are legitimate questions to investigate when there is credible evidence, but perhaps they should not become the center of the entire left-wing political struggle.
﻿
﻿Regardless of which explanation one ultimately accepts, there is a much larger historical question that deserves attention: *Why did such enormous hostility toward the United States exist in the first place?*
﻿
﻿Even if one completely rejects the idea that 9/11 was an inside job and accepts the conventional explanation that it was an attack carried out by Islamist terrorists, that still does not eliminate the question of American imperialism and its consequences. Understanding the political and historical environment in which terrorism develops is not the same thing as justifying terrorism. Explaining why someone becomes radicalized is not the same as approving of the crimes that person commits.
﻿
﻿The deeper issue, in my view, is the long history of American power abroad. The United States expanded dramatically during the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, becoming an increasingly powerful military, economic, and imperial force. From interventions in Latin America and the Caribbean to wars and military operations in Asia and the Middle East, American foreign policy has repeatedly produced enormous controversy, suffering, resentment, and resistance.
﻿
﻿I sometimes think of the United States as having inherited certain characteristics of the old imperial systems of Europe and Rome: enormous military power, economic domination, expansionism, political influence abroad, and a tendency for ruling elites to justify their actions in the name of civilization, security, freedom, or national interest. Obviously, modern America is not literally the Roman Empire, and the historical comparison has limitations. But the analogy can be useful when thinking about how republics can gradually develop imperial characteristics.
﻿
﻿And the contradictions existed from the beginning.
﻿
﻿The Declaration of Independence proclaimed that "all men are created equal," yet the society that produced it simultaneously permitted racial slavery. Millions of Africans and their descendants were subjected to a brutal system of forced labor, while the political ideals of liberty and equality were denied to them. That contradiction between American democratic ideals and American historical reality is impossible to ignore.
﻿
﻿The same contradiction continues to appear in different forms today. The United States presents itself as a champion of democracy and human rights, yet its foreign policy has frequently involved military interventions, sanctions, covert operations, alliances with authoritarian governments, and other actions that critics argue have inflicted enormous suffering on foreign populations.
﻿
﻿This does not mean that every person who opposes the United States is justified in using violence. Absolutely not. Civilians should never be treated as legitimate targets simply because of the policies of their government. But it does mean that we should seriously examine the historical causes of international hatred toward the United States instead of pretending that such hostility appeared out of nowhere.
﻿
﻿And this is where I think the American left sometimes misses an enormous part of the picture.
﻿
﻿The people who suffer under American economic and political structures are not only foreigners. *American workers themselves can be victims of the same system.*
﻿
﻿The United States is an extraordinarily wealthy country, yet enormous inequalities exist between the people who produce wealth and those who control capital, corporations, financial institutions, and political power. From a Marxist perspective, this is the fundamental contradiction of capitalism: workers create economic value through their labor, while the owners of capital appropriate a portion of the value produced by that labor as profit.
﻿
﻿Marxists describe this as exploitation and the extraction of surplus value. Whether one accepts the complete Marxist analysis or not, the underlying question is legitimate: *Who actually benefits from the enormous wealth produced by American workers?*
﻿
﻿ According to John Hammer's book *The Falsification of History*, approximately 50 percent of Americans—more than 150 million people—live in what the book describes as "extreme poverty," while only about 20 percent of the population benefits from the wealth produced by the other 80 percent.
﻿
﻿If those figures accurately represent the situation, they reveal an enormous contradiction at the heart of American society: a country that presents itself as the land of opportunity and prosperity, yet where a huge portion of the population allegedly struggles to share in the wealth that its own labor helps create.
﻿
﻿It reminds me of George Carlin's brilliant and brutally cynical observation about the so-called "American Dream": *it's called the American Dream because you have to be asleep to believe it.*
﻿
﻿The American Dream may be constantly advertised as a reality, but for millions of working people, it can feel less like a genuine opportunity and more like an ideological promise designed to keep people believing that their economic struggles are simply the result of personal failure rather than deeper structural inequalities.
﻿
﻿The broader point remains powerful: millions of American workers struggle economically while enormous fortunes are concentrated in the hands of a relatively small segment of society. That contradiction should be a central concern of the American left.
﻿
﻿And therefore, I believe the American Marxist left should spend less time destroying itself through endless ideological infighting and more time asking how working people can be organized around common economic interests.
﻿
﻿Instead of constantly arguing about which faction possesses the purest ideological doctrine, Marxists and socialists should be asking practical questions:
﻿
﻿How can workers be organized?
﻿
﻿How can unions be strengthened?
﻿
﻿How can working people be educated politically?
﻿
﻿How can economic inequality be challenged?
﻿
﻿How can racial and ethnic divisions be overcome rather than exploited?
﻿
﻿How can American workers recognize that their interests are often fundamentally different from those of billionaires, corporate executives, and political elites?
﻿
﻿And how can a genuinely internationalist socialist movement be built that recognizes that American workers and workers throughout the rest of the world have far more in common with one another than they do with their respective ruling classes?
﻿
﻿I know the idea of building a socialist organization with millions of members sounds extraordinarily ambitious, and the idea of hundreds of millions of members would be almost unimaginable under present conditions. The United States has decades of powerful anti-socialist and anti-communist traditions, reinforced through political rhetoric, popular culture, television, religious institutions, education, and other social institutions.
﻿
﻿But political movements that initially appeared impossible have sometimes grown dramatically when they successfully connected their ideas to the material experiences of ordinary people.
﻿
﻿The objective, therefore, should not simply be to convince people to call themselves "Marxists." The objective should be to demonstrate, through organization and political education, why ordinary working people might have a material interest in challenging a system that concentrates enormous economic and political power in relatively few hands.
﻿
﻿The American left should stop treating every disagreement as a reason for permanent division.
﻿
﻿The working class is far larger than any individual socialist organization.
﻿
﻿The struggle is far larger than any single political party.
﻿
﻿And the problems of capitalism are far larger than debates over ideological labels.
﻿
﻿For me, the central lesson of 9/11 should therefore not simply be an endless argument over competing conspiracy theories. It should be an examination of history: American imperialism, militarism, economic inequality, colonialism, racism, class power, and the international consequences of American foreign policy.
﻿
﻿We should investigate controversial events rigorously, follow evidence wherever it leads, and remain skeptical of official narratives when the evidence warrants skepticism. But we should also avoid allowing one historical event to consume our entire political imagination.
﻿
﻿The bigger question is not merely *"Who did 9/11?"*
﻿
﻿The bigger question is:
﻿
﻿*What kind of political and economic system produces so much power, so much inequality, so much international resentment, and so much suffering—and what can ordinary people do to change it?*
﻿
﻿That is the question I believe the Marxist left should be asking.

text: Actually...if Billy Joel means human suffering by "fire," then "we" (that is, humanity) actually did start the fire. The world has not always been this way, and it will not always remain this way. In the beginning, EVERYTHING that God created was "very good" (Genesis 1:31). But when Adam sinned, then sin, evil, and suffering entered the world (Genesis 3). But Adam ONLY isn't to blame because all humanity (you and me) sinned in him, since he stood in a position as humanity's representative (Romans 5:12-13). Consequently, we all have inherited the same sinful nature. "The Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually" (Genesis 6:5). The Lord also said, "What comes out of a person is what defiles him. For from within, out of the heart of man, come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, coveting, wickedness, deceit, sensuality, envy, slander, pride, foolishness. All these evil things come from within, and they defile a person" (Mark 7:20-23). There really is NOTHING good in us, and consequently, we all deserve the wrath of God. But the second Adam, who is Jesus Christ has come as another representative to make a new humanity (Romans 5:15-21). The Creator himself, who made EVERYTHING "very good" became a man in order to deal with the source of evil - the human heart. Through Jesus suffering, death, and physical, bodily resurrection, he has completely conquered the power of sin (Romans 6:1-14; 1 John 2:2, 3:8). "Now he commands all people everywhere to repent, because he has fixed a day on which he will judge the world in righteousness by a man whom he appointed; and of this he has given assurance to all by raising him from the dead" (Acts 17:30-31). For those who are reconciled to God through Jesus Christ, he makes them a new person and gives them a new heart (2 Corinthians 5:17). He also grants them the privilege of not only knowing him, but having eternal life in his presence in a new creation - a new heavens and new earth (Revelation 21:1-8). Therefore, be reconciled to God through Jesus Christ.

text: I watched the captions the entire time. What about "I'm gonna set my world on fire" and "watch me burn" honors Jesus Christ in any way? This is song is self serving, not God serving. Music like this is  incredibly deceiving guys. It may feel great to sing and dance to, but that is all. Christ needs to be exhalted above all else. Right after I got saved, I mean truly born again, the devil started working overtime to decieve me. I began following false teachers and listening to music with zero theology. For several months I thought I was "worshipping" but in reality, I was singing fun, exciting songs while I cleaned the house. There is a difference. I recently found a church that does traditional hymns and it is so wonderful. Every song is to bring glory to Christ alone and it is a very peaceful feeling when the entire congregation sings together. In my personal time I have had to cut out songs that I realized were spiritually harmful to me, therefore I listen to less music in general but that is a sacrifice I am willing to make. I didn't mean to offend anyone, I just get very passionate about this kind of thing because I was decieved before. God bless anyone who reads this ❤

I agree that all Christians should try and set the world on fire with their belief in Jesus.  That’s what he did after all.  However, the line that says, “So watch me burn”, makes me think the lead singer and the group want people to burn in hell.  I know this isn’t intentional, but that’s how it sounds to me.  I’m probably not the only person who has heard that either.  Also, the Saint Catherine that is mentioned in text at the end of the video is also problematic.  All Saints are actually pagan in nature.  The presence of this steals the pure joy and worship of God through the song.  I hope this is helpful.  Thank you for producing such beautiful music.  Keep up the great work.  It’s appreciated.

text: I have to be honest. I didnt start out a fan of hers, not that i didnt like her, im just into different types of music. But i have a soft spot for music that is sung so beautifully it leaves you in tears. Im going through some serious health struggles on top of mental health issues and so much more. Its music that gets me through this nightmare im living. Arianna ainging slow beautiful songs is something ive had on repeat. As weird as it sounds, its the songs that leave me in tears that give me hope. My entire life has been whats felt like a giant joke on me and im waiting for someone to say april fools because it seems theres been no good. Proceedures, medications, not being able to eat, the seizures, i officially cant walk but im trying, and the worst part is my memory is fading and im only 30. Im hoping that music and that feeling i get will help me with memory. Prayers to all going through something as well and much love to arianna. I hope you know the power your gift truly holds in a world like mine💜

text:
100 reasons to stay alive:
1. to make your parents proud
2. to conquer your fears
3. to see your family again
4. to see your favourite artist live
5. to listen to music again
6. to experience a new culture
7. to make new friends
8. to inspire
9. to have your own children
10. to adopt your own pet
11. to make yourself proud
12. to meet your idols
13. to laugh until you cry
14. to feel tears of happiness
15. to eat your favorite food
16. to see your siblings grow
17. to pass school
18. to get tattoo
19. to smile until your cheeks hurt
20. to meet your internet friends
21. to find someone who loves you like you deserve
22. to eat ice cream on a hot day
23. to drink hot chocolate on a cold day
24. to see untouched snow in the morning
25. to see a sunset that sets the sky on fire
26. to see stars light up the sky
27. to read a book that changes your life
28. to see the flowers in the spring
29. to see the leaves change from green to brown
30. to travel abroad
31. to learn a new language
32. to learn to draw
33. to tell others your story in the hopes of helping them
34. Puppy kisses.
35. Baby kisses (the open mouthed kind when they smack their lips on your cheek).
36. Swear words and the release you feel when you say them.
37. Trampolines.
38. Ice cream.
39. Stargazing.
40. Cloud watching.
41. Taking a shower and then sleeping in clean sheets.
42. Receiving thoughtful gifts.
43. “I saw this and thought of you."
44. The feeling you get when someone you love says, “I love you."
45. The relief you feel after crying.
46. Sunshine.
47. The feeling you get when someone is listening to you/giving you their full attention.
48. Your future wedding.
49. Your favorite candy bar.
50. New clothes.
51. Witty puns.
52. Really good bread.
53. Holding your child in your arms for the first time.
54. Completing a milestone (aka going to college, graduating college, getting married, getting your dream job.)
55. The kind of dreams where you wake up and can’t stop smiling.
56. The smell before and after it rains
57. The sound of rain against a rooftop.
58. The feeling you get when you’re dancing.
59. The person (or people) that mean the most to you. Stay alive for them.
60. Trying out new recipes.
61. The feeling you get when your favorite song comes on the radio.
62. The rush you get when you step onto a stage.
63. You have to share your voice and talents and knowledge with the world because they are so valuable.
64.Breakfast in bed.
65. Getting a middle seat in the movie theater.
66. Breakfast for dinner (because it’s so much better at night than in the morning).
67. Pray (if you are religious)
68. Forgiveness.
69. Water balloon fights.
70. New books by your favorite authors.
71. Fireflies.
72. Birthdays.
73. Realizing that someone loves you.
74. Spending the day with someone you
75. Opportunity to create meaningful and lasting relationships.
76. Potential to learn, grow, and evolve as a person.
77. Joy and happiness in the little things.
78. The power to inspire others.
79. The ability to create art, music, and other forms of self-expression.
80. To explore different cultures, traditions, and ways of life.
81. To make a positive impact on the environment and help protect the planet.
82. Experience the joys of parenthood and raise a family.
83. Learn new things and develop new skills.
84. Create a legacy that will outlive you.
85. Being wrapped up in a warm bed.
86. Cuddles
87. Holding hands.
88. The kind of hugs when you can feel a weight being lifted off your shoulders. The kind of hug where your breath syncs with the other person’s, and you feel like the only two people in the world.
89. Singing off key with your best friends.
90. Road trips.
91. Spontaneous adventures.
92. The feeling of sand beneath your toes.
93. The feeling when the first ocean wave rolls up and envelops your toes and ankles and knees.
94. Thunderstorms.
95. Your first (or hundredth) trip to Disneyland.
96. The taste of your favorite food.
97. The child-like feeling you get on Christmas morning.
98. The day when everything finally goes your way.
99. Compliments and praise.
100. to look on this moment in 10 years time and realize you did it.

text:
In 1999, I was backpacking through Belgium and France, on route to Spain when I heard this song. Once in the South of France, I stayed on a camping wher a DJ was doing his thing. Walked up to him and asked for this song. It was already storming the number 1 place in Belgian charts for weeks but the DJ... "never heard of it..." I really wanted to dance the sore out of my muscles so I asked for 'This love' of Pantera instead. 😎 
He went in his computer with his headphones on and announced a couple of songs later; "Mesdammes et monsieurs, it's slow time, sexy time... " I untied my long hair, started slowing with a local babe and started banging and moshing once 'the rytm' hitted. DJ was flabbergasted. Luckily there were some heavy metal fans from Sweden and they knew exactly what was coming 🤘. 
Had some great fun that night!🍻

41 “Be silent before me, you islands!
    Let the nations renew their strength!

    calling forth the generations from the beginning?

    and with the last—I am he.”

5 The islands have seen it and fear;
    the ends of the earth tremble.
They approach and come forward;
6     they help each other
    and say to their companions, “Be strong!”
7 The metalworker encourages the goldsmith,
    and the one who smooths with the hammer
    spurs on the one who strikes the anvil.
One says of the welding, “It is good.”
    The other nails down the idol so it will not topple.

8 “But you, Israel, my servant,
    Jacob, whom I have chosen,
    you descendants of Abraham my friend,
9 I took you from the ends of the earth,
    from its farthest corners I called you.
I said, ‘You are my servant’;
    I have chosen you and have not rejected you.
10 So do not fear, for I am with you;
    do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
I will strengthen you and help you;
    I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

11 “All who rage against you
    will surely be ashamed and disgraced;
those who oppose you
    will be as nothing and perish.
12 Though you search for your enemies,
    you will not find them.
Those who wage war against you
    will be as nothing at all.
13 For I am the Lord your God
    who takes hold of your right hand
and says to you, Do not fear;
    I will help you.
14 Do not be afraid, you worm Jacob,
    little Israel, do not fear,
for I myself will help you,” declares the Lord,
    your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
15 “See, I will make you into a threshing sledge,
    new and sharp, with many teeth.
You will thresh the mountains and crush them,
    and reduce the hills to chaff.
16 You will winnow them, the wind will pick them up,
    and a gale will blow them away.
But you will rejoice in the Lord
    and glory in the Holy One of Israel.

17 “The poor and needy search for water,
    but there is none;
    their tongues are parched with thirst.
But I the Lord will answer them;
    I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
18 I will make rivers flow on barren heights,
    and springs within the valleys.
I will turn the desert into pools of water,
    and the parched ground into springs.
19 I will put in the desert
    the cedar and the acacia, the myrtle and the olive.
I will set junipers in the wasteland,
    the fir and the cypress together,
20 so that people may see and know,
    may consider and understand,
that the hand of the Lord has done this,
    that the Holy One of Israel has created it.

21 “Present your case,” says the Lord.
    “Set forth your arguments,” says Jacob’s King.
22 “Tell us, you idols,
    what is going to happen.
Tell us what the former things were,
    so that we may consider them
    and know their final outcome.
Or declare to us the things to come,
23     tell us what the future holds,
    so we may know that you are gods.
Do something, whether good or bad,
    so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.
24 But you are less than nothing
    and your works are utterly worthless;
    whoever chooses you is detestable.

25 “I have stirred up one from the north, and he comes—
    one from the rising sun who calls on my name.
He treads on rulers as if they were mortar,
    as if he were a potter treading the clay.
26 Who told of this from the beginning, so we could know,
    or beforehand, so we could say, ‘He was right’?
No one told of this,
    no one foretold it,
    no one heard any words from you.
27 I was the first to tell Zion, ‘Look, here they are!’
    I gave to Jerusalem a messenger of good news.
28 I look but there is no one—
    no one among the gods to give counsel,
    no one to give answer when I ask them.
29 See, they are all false!
    Their deeds amount to nothing;
    their images are but wind and confusion.

text:
@mikedoro6461 the little boy (& others) go to bring all they have to the Baby in the manger - themselves - and all they are. Notice the burning ship they pass- meaning no going back.  The little boy sets his drum & sticks down (all he has & his worship) at the manger and leaves it all with the Lord.  Acknowledging He is King of Kings and Lord and Master over him. He walks away totally reliant on the Savior. No going back.  I’ve found their songs to have very deep messages and very well portrayed in their videos. I know there’s no mention of a ‘little drummer boy’ in the Biblical record of the birth of Jesus but I still absolutely love this song.  That last line ‘then HE smiled at me!’ What an awesome thought that one day when we’ve trusted and surrendered everything to Him and we see Him face to face, we will see Him smile at us!  🙌. 
Merry Christmas and God bless!

text:
Quiero compartir la historia que tiene esta hermosa canción para mi. 

Conocí a una chica un verano hace algunos años mediante un amigo, comenzamos a salir y entre varias idas y vueltas terminamos en una relación. 
Ella tenía depresión, no encontraba una salida o cosas que la motivaran pero en mis ojos yo veía todo su esfuerzo y su lucha día a día, algo que en verdad admiraba. 

Tenía tantas increibles cualidades que me enamoraron muy rápidamente como su sinceridad, su lealtad y tambien su forma de arriesgarse a divertirse y a permitirse ser amada a pesar del riesgo que conlleva y todo el dolor que le habían causado anteriormente. Su forma tan romántica de hacer la diferencia hasta en los más mínimos detalles hizo que hasta el día de hoy piense en ella y sonría. 

Pero nuestra relación no duró más de cuatro meses ya que afrontamos muchas situaciones difíciles pero siempre recuerdo la vez que me enseño esta hermosa canción y como realmente sucedió en nuestra relación lo que la misma dice "nos esforzamos mucho para arreglarlo, pero lo rompimos más". 

Aunque al final yo si me despedí y intente no volver a tener comunicación por lo que pensé que no era el momento o no estábamos destinados a estar juntos en ese momento "siempre pienso que tal vez un día pueda verte, podamos sonreír y saludarnos, y estará bien".

text: One day I'll probably delete this post or laugh at it. But now ... It hurts like hell. Damn it. The feeling when you feel that your two-year relationship, all the beautiful experiences, all the moments of closeness are probably coming to an end. I arranged an apartment for us. I overcame his snooping in my phone, my purse, pressure to not be in friendly message-contact with my ex bf. I forgave him rent, he only pays for consumption. I gave him new phone. It was me who wanted to spend Christmas and New Year's Eve together, because that´s what couples just do. I did such beautiful holidays that he didn't experience himself ... Eventually I heard that I was lazy, even though he knew it wasn't true. Such disrespect for me, whom he claims to love and wants to live with... After all those things, it broke me. I wanted to break up, the word was already heard. After the new year, he decided to go home to his parents on the weekends, across the country, to calm the situation. I am alone here. Every weekend. He only comes back here in the evening when he has a job during the week. We were supposed to spend this weekend together, the first since the argument. Even though we don't celebrate Valentine's Day, I made us a cake, simply because it's a nice gesture for the other. He arrived empty-handed, and even after a few days he didn't think of coming to the revenge with any trifles. On the contrary, when he found out I had to work this weekend unfortunately, he left again, saying, "Haven't I been here enough for those two years?" ..Are you really serious..? He could have made us lunch, taken care of the household, we could at least hug in the evening and watch a movie ... anything. No. Apparently it was better to leave......  IS THIS WHAT LOVE AND CARE FOR ANOTHER REALLY LOOKS LIKE? .....The feeling when all the effort is in vain ... I feel so miserable. Alone in this apartment. So sorry. With all memories of us. In every corner......... No, Dua, we can't pretend that it's all alright. We can't pretend these are not goodbyes. No more pretty lies. Not even for this one night. The love of each of us is different.

“Let’s Fall in Love for the Night” is FINNEAS' tenth solo single to be released, and the last of two singles to be released by the singer over the course of two weeks in October 2018.

The track is one of the singer’s most “classical pop” songs yet, as acknowledged by the singer in an interview with Billboard:

I love pop songs so much and I don’t put a ton of pressure on myself as a solo artist to always write the most commercial feeling thing, I just want to write things I would love to listen to. This feels like one of those.

In the same interview, the singer and songwriter also shared his inspiration for this song, which came in August of 2018, when he was in Osaka, Japan touring with his sister, rising artist Billie Eilish:

I was in Osaka, Japan, FaceTiming a girl I’d never met every day and knowing there was nothing I could really do about it. I wrote this song about the day I would fantasize having with her.

Its release was first teased in a tweet on October, 10, 2018:

What did FINNEAS say about "Let's Fall in Love for the Night"?

Genius Answer

In an interview with Billboard, Finneas revealed:

I wrote this song last August while we were on tour in Japan. It was about a million degrees outside, so at the end of each day, I’d lie down on my hotel bed and turn the AC on full blast and play these chords. The chorus came first, then the first verse. The second verse was [written on] a completely different day, but that’s why I like that part so much.

What has Finneas said about the production of the song?

Genius Answer
1 contributor
In an interview with Pitchfork, Finneas explained:

I liked it at this really slow tempo and I also liked itwith kind of a backbeat and this sort of Gorillaz “Feel Good Inc” rhythm running through it. One of the things that I always try to do in my production is help articulate shifts in certain ways, so I really wanted the moment where the drums break in and the bass breaks in to feel sort of enhanced and accentuated, and I felt that the easiest way to do that was to muffle all of the high end out of the intro and then to just pump in to a hi-fi feeling with the drums and the bass. The other good example I could give is that the same kind of effect happens on the beginning of “Mr. Brightside” by The Killers, and in that one, they use panning in a really interesting way. They have the guitar hard panned and the drums hard panned and the vocal is really muffled. And then when the second part of the first verse comes in, it all busts out into a million hertz. It’s probably the primary inspiration. At the end of the track, when the drums and the bass cut out and it just goes to only acoustic guitar and only my vocal, I wanted to sort of keep some ear candy in and so I layered in this recording of frogs and crickets in a field up in northern California. The challenge was just being willing to abandon ship at the end of the song, and have the last 45 seconds be a live take, which is kind of risky because sometimes you can lose a lot of momentum. But I felt that in that song’s case, it needed to have this super different feeling for the last 45 seconds.

text:
Idea Principal (I.P.)
Tesis
La despenalización del aborto en casos de violación debe permitirse.
Conector causal
Porque
Argumento
La vida no solo significa existir, sino también garantizar el bienestar físico, emocional y psicológico de la mujer que ha sufrido violencia.
Idea Secundaria (I.S.)
Definición
Término a definir: Vida
Verbo: es
Género próximo: un derecho fundamental
Diferencia específica: que implica vivir con bienestar físico, emocional y psicológico, respetando la dignidad de la persona.
Ideas Terciarias (I.T.)
I.T.1
La mujer víctima de violación puede sufrir daños psicológicos y emocionales graves.
I.T.2
La despenalización del aborto busca proteger la salud y dignidad de la mujer.
I.T.3. Autor (Año): Presentación de información
Según la Organización Mundial de la Salud (2022), la salud incluye el bienestar físico, mental y social de las personas.
Explicación 1
Obligar a una mujer violada a continuar un embarazo puede afectar gravemente su salud mental.
Explicación 2
Por ello, algunos países consideran que la despenalización del aborto en estos casos protege los derechos humanos y la dignidad femenina.
